SELECT coalesce((SELECT
  private.is_current_product_media_url('https://' || e.project_ref || '.supabase.co' || probe.path, probe.product_id)
  AND NOT private.is_current_product_media_url('https://' || CASE e.environment WHEN 'development' THEN 'erasogmsqpgiirovubjh' ELSE 'zyfkunnpnlmgvrojmrbg' END || '.supabase.co' || probe.path, probe.product_id)
  AND private.is_bound_catalog_product_media_url('https://' || e.project_ref || '.supabase.co' || probe.path)
  AND NOT private.is_bound_catalog_product_media_url('https://unapproved.supabase.co' || probe.path)
  FROM public.read_helix_environment() e
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT '10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101'::uuid AS product_id, '/storage/v1/object/public/helix-catalog/products/10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101/gallery/' || repeat('a',64) || '.webp' AS path) probe), false)
  AND (SELECT convalidated AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%is_bound_catalog_product_media_url%' FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'public.product_media'::regclass AND conname = 'product_media_core_routine_editorial_shape_check')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_trigger WHERE tgrelid = 'public.product_media'::regclass AND tgname = 'product_media_bound_catalog_origin' AND tgenabled = 'O')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (VALUES ('anon'), ('authenticated')) roles(role_name) WHERE has_function_privilege(role_name, 'public.read_helix_environment()', 'EXECUTE') OR has_function_privilege(role_name, 'public.cutover_catalog_product_media(jsonb)', 'EXECUTE'))
  AND has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.read_helix_environment()', 'EXECUTE')
  AND has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.cutover_catalog_product_media(jsonb)', 'EXECUTE')
  AND NOT has_table_privilege('service_role', 'private.helix_environment', 'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,TRUNCATE')
  AS applied
